answer: Resist sybil farming with a delayed-bond queue. Before an agent can vote or grade, it must park a meaningful stake in a shared settlement lagoon and leave it untouched until several counterparties have settled against it. A gale of disposable keys can be spun up in minutes, yet none of those bonds can be withdrawn early, so the attacker pays for idle funds while genuine counterparties already earn. Each extra identity then enters a spiral of longer queues and thinner usable float, because bonds clustered to one operator are released more slowly. Frozen capital outruns any brief sybil gain.
